about: The mishearing skit as a radio play. Each line: who, voice, text, direction (how it is acted), gapBeforeMs (silence before it, from the end of the previous line's tail). A line with parts is recorded as one take; the parts are found again from its pauses.

lines.direction: Casual and a little distracted, talking to a smart speaker while cooking. Brisk, everyday pace, no drawn-out words.

lines.text: Whoops, missed that... Was it fifteen or fifty? ... Nah. Definitely fifty.
lines.direction: A speech recognizer muttering to itself, fast. A quick sheepish 'whoops, missed that', then genuinely unsure: 'was it fifteen or fifty?', a tiny beat, then smug and completely certain: 'nah, definitely fifty.' Comic timing, brisk.
Flat, polite, bored customer-service tone. Quick.
Absent-minded, still cooking, not really listening. Quick.
